d:
After falling behind by 17 points, Türkiye refused to give up and fought their way back into the game against Finland!
With just seconds left and trailing 68-65, Cenk Akyol stepped up and drained a CLUTCH three-pointer to tie the game and send it to overtime!
Then Kerem Gonlum and Emir Preldzic took over in OT, helping Türkiye complete the comeback and secure a thrilling 77-73 victory!
A HUGE comeback, a clutch shot and an unforgettable finish!
